title: Housing (Right to Buy) (Limits on Discount) (England) Order 2024
amendmentMotionNotes: The Earl of Effingham moved that this House regrets that the Housing (Right to Buy) (Limits on Discount) (England) Order 2024 (SI 2024/1073), laid before the House on 30 October, will reduce the number of social tenants who can purchase their property, undermine home ownership and cut new house building. The House divided:
